name: Customer Product Specification-ctn_flap_mm
Customer Product Specification-html_board_plan
options:
Board Plan Calculation Reference

Blank Width (1-UP) = Flap + Carton Height + Flap (RSC)  |  H + Flap (1-Flap RSC)  |  W + 2H (Tray)

Blank Length (1-UP) = (2 × Carton Length) + (2 × Carton Width) + Tab (30mm)

Planned Board Width = Blank Width + 2 × Trim per Edge

Planned Board Length = Blank Length + 2 × Trim per Edge

Trim is per outer edge — standard 10 mm/edge (20 mm total). Approximate Weight (g) = (Planned Width × Planned Length / 1,000,000) × Total GSM. Knife gap, max reel width and the UPS forecast live on the Job Card.
